items.title: Why Stocks Could Rally if PPI Inflation Comes in Below Expectations
items.summary: Investors were in wait-and-see mode on Thursday. There's a lot riding on the looming wholesale inflation report. Economists expect the data to show producer prices rose at a rate of 4.9% last month, according to a FactSet poll.

items.title: Infleqtion Stock Falls After Earnings Report. How NASA Boosted Revenue.
items.summary: Infleqtion Infleqtion  second quarter numbers tell a familiar tech growth story: near-term losses continued to widen, even as demand for its array of quantum technologies push revenue higher.  Infleqtion ultimately reported a wider loss of 12 cents per share, though revenue beat projections at $12.6 million, a 116% jump from the prior year.  Widening losses are par for the course among early-stage quantum computing companies.
